Q020.reason: The Marshall Plan was the 1948 American program of economic aid to rebuild postwar Europe.

Q021.reason: NSC 68 (1950) called for a major military buildup, marking a shift from economic containment toward military containment.

Q022.reason: The Monroe Doctrine (1823) warned European powers to stay out of the Western Hemisphere, including Latin America.

Q023.reason: The Truman Doctrine (1947) framed aid to Greece and Turkey as a global commitment to resist communism, extending containment to local revolts worldwide.

Q024.reason: A multipolar system has three or more major powers, while bipolar has two and unipolar has one.
